user_need: As a policy officer, I need to focus on the evidence relevant to the policy topic of my briefing.
requirement_description: The service shall allow the user to select a policy topic and restrict all views and counts to that topic.
acceptance_criterion: After selecting a topic, every displayed finding and every count relates only to the selected topic.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - topic selector at the top of the page (app.py). Two synthetic topics are loaded; topics, themes and projects are read from the data.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need support in organising evidence while I retain responsibility for interpretation and drafting.
requirement_description: The service shall produce a structured evidence overview for human review and shall not generate policy recommendations or judge policy options.
acceptance_criterion: No screen or export contains generated recommendations or rankings of policy options; a human review step is described on screen.
prototype_coverage: Partially implemented - no recommendations are generated and the review step is described; there is no formal review or sign-off workflow.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to find research findings relevant to my topic quickly.
requirement_description: The service shall list individual findings for the selected topic and support keyword search across finding title, description and caveats.
acceptance_criterion: Entering a keyword returns only findings containing that keyword (case-insensitive) in the searched fields.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - findings explorer and keyword filter (app.py, data_utils.filter_findings).

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to narrow the evidence to specific themes, projects or evidence types.
requirement_description: The service shall provide optional filters for thematic category, project and evidence type, derived from the data, and a single action to reset all filters.
acceptance_criterion: Each filter reduces the results to matching findings only; counts update accordingly; 'Reset filters' restores the unfiltered view for the selected topic.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - sidebar filters and reset button; covered by automated tests.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to see what several projects collectively report on the same theme.
requirement_description: The service shall present findings grouped by theme and allow findings from different projects on one theme to be read side by side, with an overview of coverage per theme and project.
acceptance_criterion: For a selected theme, findings from all matching projects appear in a single comparison table with project, evidence type, caveats and source reference.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - 'Findings by theme' and 'Compare across projects' tabs, including a theme-by-project coverage matrix.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to check where each finding comes from before using it.
requirement_description: Each displayed finding shall show its project, source document and source reference.
acceptance_criterion: 100% of displayed findings show a non-empty project, source document and source reference.
prototype_coverage: Implemented with synthetic references only - real document links are not available in the prototype (see DR-03).

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to understand the limitations of each finding to avoid overstating it.
requirement_description: Each finding shall display its evidence type and stated limitations or caveats; general limitations of the dataset shall be visible on screen.
acceptance_criterion: Every finding card shows evidence type and a non-empty caveat; a general limitations section is visible without additional navigation beyond scrolling.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - caveats on each finding and an 'Evidence limitations and human review' section.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to distinguish what a project reported from any later interpretation.
requirement_description: The service shall present findings as reported by the source and visibly separate them from any interpretation, annotation or synthesis added by users or tools.
acceptance_criterion: Reported findings are explicitly labelled; any interpretive content is labelled with its author or origin and is never merged into the finding text.
prototype_coverage: Partially implemented - findings are labelled 'Reported finding (synthetic)' and the prototype adds no interpretation; annotation by users is not implemented.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need to reuse the filtered evidence when preparing my briefing.
requirement_description: The service shall allow the current filtered set of findings, including source references, to be exported.
acceptance_criterion: The export file contains exactly the findings in the current view, each with its source reference.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - CSV download in the 'Table and export' tab.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need confidence that each finding is linked to the correct project and source.
requirement_description: The data model shall use stable identifiers; every finding shall reference an existing project and have a source reference. Records failing these checks shall not be displayed.
acceptance_criterion: Automated checks confirm unique IDs and that all findings reference an existing project; untraceable findings are excluded and reported.
prototype_coverage: Implemented - validation and exclusion in data_utils.py; covered by automated tests.

user_need: As a data steward, I need consistent metadata so that findings can be compared reliably.
requirement_description: The service shall apply a documented metadata schema (topic, theme, evidence type, caveat, source) and report data quality issues.
acceptance_criterion: A data quality check lists missing columns, duplicate IDs, orphan findings and empty source fields; a controlled vocabulary for themes and evidence types is documented.
prototype_coverage: Partially implemented - structural checks only; no controlled vocabulary, curation workflow or evidence quality assessment.

user_need: As a policy officer, I need the evidence base to be real, sufficiently complete and verifiable.
requirement_description: The pilot shall use findings curated from real project outputs, with document-level references and working links, and documented coverage and selection criteria.
acceptance_criterion: A sample review confirms that each finding's reference resolves to the cited document and the finding is consistent with it; coverage criteria are published with the dataset.
prototype_coverage: Not implemented - the prototype uses synthetic data only.

user_need: As a data owner, I need non-public or restricted material to be accessible only to authorised users.
requirement_description: The service shall respect the access conditions of each source, including confidentiality of non-public project deliverables, and apply appropriate access control.
acceptance_criterion: Access rules are agreed with data owners; a test user without permission cannot view restricted records.
prototype_coverage: Not implemented - out of prototype scope; the prototype uses only synthetic, non-confidential data and has no authentication.

user_need: As a policy officer with limited time and no technical background, I need the service to be easy to use.
requirement_description: The service shall use plain language, require no technical knowledge and work on a standard laptop screen.
acceptance_criterion: In a usability session, representative users complete a defined evidence-finding task without assistance within an agreed time.
prototype_coverage: Partially implemented - plain-language interface; no usability testing has been carried out.

user_need: As a service owner, I need to understand whether AI could reduce the manual effort of curating findings.
requirement_description: AI-assisted extraction, classification or synthesis of findings from raw project documents.
acceptance_criterion: Not applicable for this pilot. A later evaluation would compare AI output with expert-curated findings on a reference sample.
prototype_coverage: Not implemented - deliberately excluded; see docs/implementation-and-risks.md.
